summary: Quhuo Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing the termination of its American Depositary Receipt program and a share consolidation, with the resulting Class A ordinary shares to trade directly on Nasdaq under symbol QH. The ADR program termination is effective July 17, 2026, with each ADS converting to 0.84375 post-consolidation shares after a 32,000-for-1 reverse split. The board and shareholders approved the plan. The move replaces the ADR listing with direct ordinary share listing, simplifying the corporate structure. Watch for the successful transition of share settlement and any residual trading or custody issues post-delisting of the ADSs.
